# The TeX and raster toolchain, installed identically by ci.yml and publish.yml.
#
# One file rather than two inline lists, because they drifted once already: publish.yml was
# still missing texlive-latex-extra after ci.yml gained it, which would have failed a release
# at the Test step, minutes in, with the OIDC exchange never reached.
#
# What each one is for:
#   texlive-latex-base         the LaTeX core
#   texlive-latex-extra        standalone.cls, which every emitted document begins with
#   texlive-latex-recommended  textcomp
#   texlive-pictures           tikz/pgf
#   texlive-science            siunitx (and, as a hard Depends, texlive-lang-greek -- 79 MB,
#                              over half this list's download, unavoidable while we use siunitx)
#   poppler-utils              pdftoppm, for the ink gate
#
# Changing this file changes the apt cache key in both workflows, so a package added here is
# fetched fresh once and then cached.
texlive-latex-base
texlive-latex-extra
texlive-latex-recommended
texlive-pictures
texlive-science
poppler-utils
